name: git-sim
description: See what a Git command will do before you run it, and watch your repository change live: interactive before / after simulations, deterministic pre-flight checks and a live graph of your real repository, powered by git-sim.

commands.title: Live graph: follow the repository as it changes
Show the live graph in the sidebar
Wire git-sim into AI coding agents

walkthroughs.title: See what Git is doing with git-sim
walkthroughs.description: Simulate a command before you run it, pre-flight a risky one, and follow your repository live, including what an AI agent does in it.

steps.title: Install git-sim
steps.description:
The extension drives the git-sim command line, which needs Python 3.10 or newer and Git.
[Install git-sim](command:git-sim.installGitSim)
The status bar shows a beaker with "git-sim" once it is found.

steps.title: Simulate a command
steps.description:
Press Ctrl+Alt+G (Cmd+Alt+G on a Mac), finish the command as you would in a terminal, and watch it play out on a graph of your repository.
[Simulate a Git command](command:git-sim.simulate)

steps.title: Pre-flight a risky one
steps.description:
Before a reset, a rebase or a force push, get the facts: what becomes unreachable, what would be lost, how to undo it.
[Pre-flight a Git command](command:git-sim.preflight)

steps.title: Follow your repository live
steps.description:
A graph that plays every commit, branch, reset or rebase as it happens, whoever made it. In a tab, or in the git-sim view you can drag next to your chat or terminal.
[Open the live graph](command:git-sim.live)
[Show it in the sidebar](command:git-sim.liveSidebar)

steps.title: Put a human in the loop with your AI agents
steps.description:
One command wires the pre-flight hook and the MCP server into Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and more, so a destructive Git command stops for your approval with the facts in front of you.
[Wire git-sim into AI coding agents](command:git-sim.installAgents)

steps.title: Learn Git on the same graphs
steps.description:
Sixteen guided levels at initialcommit.com, played on git-sim graphs.
[Open the lessons](command:git-sim.openLearn)

git-sim.executable.description: The git-sim executable. Leave as 'git-sim' when it is on your PATH (pipx install git-sim, or uv tool install git-sim); otherwise the full path.

git-sim.extraArgs.description: Extra global options passed to every simulation, for example ["--no-reverse"] or ["--all"]. See git-sim --help.

git-sim.followEditorTheme.description: Draw simulations in light mode when the editor's colour theme is light.

git-sim.openInBrowser.description: Open simulations in your browser instead of an editor tab.

git-sim.openHookSimulations.description: When git-sim's pre-flight hook stops an AI agent's risky git command, open the interactive simulation it rendered in an editor tab.

git-sim.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for git-sim before giving up.

enumDescriptions: In editor tabs only: the sidebar view is too narrow for the table and shows the graph alone.
Under every live graph, sidebar included.
git-sim.liveZones.description: Whether the live graph draws the untracked / modified / staged table under the commit graph.

git-sim.liveInterval.description: Seconds between checks of the repository in live mode. Each check runs a few quick git commands.
